items.question: What is Truestack Insights?
items.answer: Truestack Insights is where we write up what we learn from client work in Malaysian fintech — licences, loan books, and the software around them. Each article answers a question someone has already asked us. When a next step is a product or service we offer, we say so and link it.

items.question: Who should read these articles?
items.answer: Anyone running a licensed money lender, applying for a KPKT digital licence, or building regulated financial software in Malaysia. Owners, compliance managers and product leads will see the terms they already use — Lampiran reporting, CTOS, SSM, Tawarruq. If an article points to a next step, we link the matching product or service, such as TrueKredit™ or KPKT licence advisory.

items.question: How often do you publish new insights?
items.answer: Usually one to four articles a month. We would rather wait than publish something thin. New pieces show up here as soon as they are live.

items.question: How do I ask a question you have not written about yet?
items.answer: Book a free consultation and tell us where you are stuck. We will map what applies to your situation and your timeline. There is no obligation to buy software or a service.

postCta.body: Book a free consultation. Tell us your licence type and where you are stuck — we will tell you what applies to you and what does not.
